fixture.shape: exactly one human-written question per repository

protocol.scoring: exact labeled file path within top-k of results from the requested repository

meaning.repoCoverage: the requested repository returned at least one of its own passages. This is an AVAILABILITY check, NOT answer accuracy.
meaning.hitTop5: the exact pre-labeled file appeared in the top 5. Equivalent content under a different filename scores as a MISS and is not given retrospective credit.
meaning.notMeasured: generated-answer correctness and citation support were NOT evaluated. Unscoped (whole-corpus) discovery was NOT measured.
meaning.c3: ADR-086 C3 (>=95% Hit@5 per repository on the machine-generated oracle) is NOT demonstrated by this report and was NOT met; its diagnostic result is published alongside.
